name: hamster
description: Connect your agent to Supabuild: ask the Discovery agent, read your team's knowledge, and follow delivery threads.

interface.longDescription: Supabuild is a team workspace where agents turn conversation into delivered software. This plugin connects your agent to Supabuild's remote MCP server. Ask the Discovery agent, which researches, drafts and proposes team knowledge and starts delivery threads. Read your team's knowledge: decisions, scopes, methods and goals, each marked accepted, proposed or historical. Follow delivery threads as coding agents carry work from clarified requirements to committed changes, a preview and a verified deployment. You sign in with OAuth in your client, and each connection is scoped to one project you choose. Accepting proposed knowledge stays a person's decision in the web app.
